name: Review route → NO VERDICT: reviewer terminated without submitting → park (fail-closed)
description:
The fail-closed no-verdict park (design R4/SB5, group 5). If Quinn's review loop TERMINATES without ever recording a verdict (she ran out of iterations, or called ask_human, or errored) — route.verdict is absent — the run cannot proceed on a missing judgment. This PARKS toward the human. This is the totality catch of the review route: route.verdict ∈ {approved (07a), changes_requested (07b/07c), ABSENT (here)} — no path silently advances (SB5, fail-closed).

TRIGGER = Quinn's review LOOP identified by agent.loop.role eq "reviewer" (required:true — the one reviewer loop; route.verdict is absent here so it cannot be the discriminator) AND agent.loop.outcome ne "" (required:false — the loop terminated; ne "" on absent is false, so it never fires mid-loop) AND route.verdict length_eq 0 (required:true — no verdict was mirrored) AND route.routed length_eq 0 (self-extinguish). Mutually exclusive with 07a/07b/07c, which all require route.verdict PRESENT.

WRITER: run.awaiting_human — a sanctioned park realization (G5). SELF-EXTINGUISHING: route.routed on the review loop (a LOOP-scoped guard).

on_enter.subject: $entity.triple.agent.run.entity_id
on_enter.object: the reviewer loop terminated without submitting a verdict (out of iterations, escalated, or errored); no approval to act on

metadata.station: review no-verdict → park (fail-closed totality catch, R4/SB5, group 5)
metadata.totality: route.verdict ∈ {approved, changes_requested, ABSENT}; this catches ABSENT (a terminated reviewer loop that never submitted), so no review path silently advances.
metadata.restart_safe: SELF-EXTINGUISHING via the LOOP-scoped route.routed marker.
